description: This file is part of the 'fmt' formatting library for C++, providing formatters for standard library types such as filesystem paths, bitsets, optional, expected, source_location, type_info, exceptions, and various atomic and complex types. It includes conditional compilation for different C++ standards and features, and defines formatter specializations for these types.

classes.name: formatter<std::filesystem::path, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::filesystem::path, supporting custom formatting options and escaping.

classes.name: formatter<std::bitset<N>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::bitset, displaying bits as '0' and '1'.

classes.name: formatter<std::optional<T>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::optional, displaying 'none' or the contained value.

classes.name: formatter<std::expected<T, E>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::expected, displaying 'expected' or 'unexpected' with value or error.

classes.name: formatter<std::source_location>
classes.description: Formatter for std::source_location, displaying file, line, column, and function.

classes.name: formatter<std::type_info, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::type_info, demangling type names.

classes.name: formatter<std::error_code>
classes.description: Formatter for std::error_code, displaying category name and value.

classes.name: formatter<std::monostate, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::monostate, representing an empty variant.

classes.name: formatter<std::variant<...>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::variant, displaying contained value or valueless state.

classes.name: formatter<std::complex<T>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::complex, supporting real and imaginary parts.

classes.name: formatter<std::reference_wrapper<T>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::reference_wrapper, forwarding to the referenced object.

classes.name: formatter<std::atomic<T>, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::atomic, displaying the loaded value.

classes.name: formatter<std::atomic_flag, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::atomic_flag, displaying test() result.

classes.name: formatter<std::exception, Char>
classes.description: Formatter for std::exception, optionally including type name.
